result:
Todo REST API done. Node+TS+Express, in-memory store, all 5 endpoints, validation with `{error}` shape, 7/7 tests green, strict-mode build clean, README with setup/run/endpoints.

Worth flagging: this devbox's toolchain resolved to bleeding-edge majors (TypeScript 7 native compiler, Express 5) — TS7 dropped the JS API `ts-jest` needs, so tests run against the classic compiler published as `@typescript/typescript6`, aliased as `typescript` in package.json. Both `tsc` (build) and Jest (test) use that one compiler, strict mode throughout.

Also hit unrelated infra on this shared box squatting on port 3000 (something under `~/dev/garrison`'s port-management fittings), which blocked my own loopback curl checks against 3000 specifically — confirmed it's not my app's fault by running the identical server code on a free port and driving it through the full REST flow (create, validation errors, get, patch, filter, delete, 404) over real HTTP, all correct.
